security_spec.violation_condition: OpenSBI writes the full saved mie value via csr_write(CSR_MIE, saved_mie) during HSM non-retentive suspend restore (sbi_hsm.c:444) without re-reading CSR_MIE to verify that WARL legalization did not silently drop implemented-but-writability-restricted interrupt-enable bits; same pattern applies to platform suspend hooks that write mie to a wakeup mask (e.g., fdt_hsm_sifive_tmc0.c:272, fdt_hsm_andes_atcsmu.c:153)
security_spec.summary: M-mode interrupt CSRs mie/mip are WARL per normative rule; OpenSBI save/restore during HSM suspend/resume writes full saved mie without post-write re-read verification, risking silently dropped interrupt-enable bits and post-resume interrupt starvation on platforms with partial bit-set writability
